Research Collaborator Recommendation
Social Network Analysis AAT
A structural link prediction experiment on Stanford SNAP ca-GrQc
Problem and objectives
Rank currently unconnected researchers using co-authorship structure.
Compare four transparent scores and evaluate missing-link recovery.
Export exact global top 10 and top 20 rankings.
Dataset and graph model
5,242 researcher IDs and 14,484 cleaned co-authorship edges.
Simple, undirected and unweighted graph.
arXiv GR-QC papers: January 1993 to April 2003.
Source: snap.stanford.edu/data/ca-GrQc.html
Four prediction methods
Common Neighbors: number of shared collaborators.
Jaccard: shared / combined collaborators.
Adamic-Adar: sum of 1 / ln(shared neighbor degree).
Preferential Attachment: degree(u) x degree(v).
Reproducible evaluation
Primary seed 42. Random 80/20 split of unique edges.
Keep every node in training, including isolates.
Use one full-graph nonedge per held-out positive.
Score only the training graph. Ties use ascending IDs.
Evaluation metrics
ROC-AUC measures positive/negative ranking quality.
Precision@K = hits / K. Recall@K = hits / test positives.
F1@K is the harmonic mean of precision and recall at K.
Balanced sampled precision differs from all-nonedge precision.
Primary results
Highest primary ROC-AUC: Adamic-Adar (0.88894).
Winner Precision@10: 1.000; Precision@20: 1.000.
Same test results select the winner, without independent validation.
Split sensitivity
Repeat the protocol with seeds 7, 21 and 84.
The primary split remains seed 42.

Exact collaborator recommendations
All 13,722,177 unordered nonedges are scored.
Four heaps retain only 20 records each, with no candidate filter.
Example (Adamic-Adar): IDs 45 and 46, 42 shared collaborators.
Final recommendations use the full observed graph.

Application demonstration

Open Researcher Profile for local structure and personal suggestions.
Limitations and conclusion
IDs supply no names, interests or compatibility evidence.
Sampled nonedges are assumed negatives.
Random edge recovery does not prove future prediction.
Structural scores provide explainable possibilities for further study.
